sources.title: [Ended] Qwen3.8-Max-Preview Limited-Time Offer
sources.evidence: The exact preview is named a Qwen flagship with 2.4T parameters. Access through Qoder products and the promotion begin July 19, 2026. The page describes coding and professional productivity use and an evolving preview. Updated August 26; historical offer has ended. It does not disclose architecture or active parameters.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Max-Preview All-Day 90 Percent Off, Off-Peak Up to 98 Percent Off
sources.evidence: Qoder's launch promotion identifies Qwen3.8-Max-Preview as a Qwen foundation model with 2.4T parameters and starts July 19, 2026. It documents model selection and use across Qoder products, ending August 3. This is exact-preview evidence rather than a transfer from the later GA model.

sources.evidence: Official Qwen Code pull request merged July 19, 2026, adds the exact preview to the Alibaba Cloud Token Plan list and explicitly describes 1M context, thinking mode, and image/video input. This historical integration corroborates availability on July 19.

sources.title: Qwen Code Alibaba Token Plan preset at b0b654bc17e86c1e95c70853cedbc61b78577799
sources.evidence: Pinned official source defines qwen3.8-max-preview with contextWindowSize 1000000, enableThinking true, and image/video modalities true in the OpenAI-compatible conversational provider.

sources.title: Model outputs XML-style tool calls as plain text instead of structured function calls in long sessions
sources.evidence: On July 29, Qwen Code collaborator doudouOUC explicitly confirms a qwen3.8-max-preview model-side tool-call format-adherence issue, distinguishes normal structured tool_calls from erroneous text responses, and says the model-team fix will be escalated internally. This establishes historical function-calling support, not perfect reliability; unverified training-data hypotheses are not used.

sources.title: Token Plan Individual
sources.evidence: Current official documentation says qwen3.8-max-preview has been retired and requests using the old ID are automatically routed to qwen3.8-max. This is an endpoint migration, not evidence that the original preview shares every GA specification. No API request was made to test present operation.

sources.title: [Alibaba Cloud Model Studio] Model Upgrade Notice
sources.evidence: The August 4, 2026 notice announces retirement of Qwen3.8-Max-Preview and routing to the official Qwen3.8-Max release. Its prose names August 5 while its affected-time header states August 6 00:00 UTC+08 subject to the actual change time; therefore the report does not assert an exact retirement timestamp.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B official model card
sources.evidence: The later open checkpoint is described as the first Qwen-Max-class open release. Its card maps the checkpoint to Qwen3.8-Max, discloses a 2.4T/95B MoE language model, and says hosted Max adds vision and other features. The card and benchmark table do not identify Qwen3.8-Max-Preview, so its architecture, active count and weight license are not transferred to this preview.

sources.evidence: Identified as the launch post by linked coverage, but direct retrieval returned HTTP 403 and a search did not recover its contents. Claims are based on accessible official Qoder documentation and the historical Qwen Code integration instead.

name.note: Display-name normalization of the exact official name Qwen3.8-Max-Preview.

developer.note: Alibaba Cloud and the Qwen team's official integration identify this as their Qwen flagship preview.

family.note: The exact preview is explicitly a member of the Qwen / Tongyi Qianwen family.

release_date.note: Earliest public preview availability supported by the launch promotion beginning July 19 and the same-day official client integration. This is not the later GA release, an open-checkpoint date, or a snapshot identifier. The inaccessible social post is not treated as independently read evidence.

open_weights.note: The exact hosted variant is documented, but no exact released weights or explicit primary closed-weight classification was verified. A separate checkpoint or an unsuccessful repository search does not prove this variant is closed.

license.note: No exact weight artifact and corresponding license were verified for this hosted variant. API terms and other checkpoint or companion-software licenses do not establish a weight license here.

parameters_b.note: Nominal developer-reported total of 2.4 trillion parameters, converted to 2400 billion. Both primary pages name the exact preview; this is not an exact tensor count or a value inferred from GA Max.

active_parameters_b.note: No active count is disclosed for the exact preview in the inspected primary material. The later 95B checkpoint/GA figure lacks an exact-preview mapping; neither total parameters nor a presumed architecture supplies the missing value.

architecture.note: Exact-preview primary pages disclose scale but not architecture. Later official MoE/checkpoint descriptions and comparison cards do not identify the preview as that architecture, so MoE is not copied backward.

context_window.note: The historical official client preset explicitly sets 1000000 tokens for the exact preview. It is a service context limit, not a checkpoint-native context or output limit.

modalities.note: Official historical conversational integration explicitly enables image and video input in addition to text; the exact-preview issue documents generated textual content and structured tool-call messages. No image/audio/video generation capability is asserted.

reasoning.note: Exact-preview integration explicitly sets enableThinking true and describes thinking-mode support.

tool_call.note: A Qwen Code collaborator confirms the exact preview's structured function-call protocol and a format-adherence defect during long sessions. Support does not imply every invocation was correctly formatted; the report does not adopt speculative claims about its training data.

description.value: Hosted Qwen3.8 preview for reasoning, coding and professional tasks, with a one-million-token context and text, image and video input; later retired in favor of Qwen3.8-Max.
description.note: Uses documented positioning and historical capabilities without performance superlatives, and makes the retirement explicit.

patch.description: Hosted Qwen3.8 preview for reasoning, coding and professional tasks, with a one-million-token context and text, image and video input; later retired in favor of Qwen3.8-Max.
patch.notes: 2.4T is a nominal total published for the exact preview by Alibaba/Qoder. Preview active parameters and architecture remain undisclosed in the inspected primary sources; later GA/checkpoint 95B/MoE details are not transferred. Historical capabilities describe the preview; current documentation says its ID routes to Qwen3.8-Max. The retirement notice gives inconsistent August 5/6 timing, so no exact retirement timestamp is asserted. Exact weight-release status and a corresponding weight license remain unverified.

summary: Audited all 14 fields. Adds the exact-preview nominal total of 2400B from accessible Alibaba/Qoder primary pages, confirms July 19 preview availability and historical 1M context, text/image/video input, reasoning and function calling, and records retirement/routing to GA Max. Active parameters and architecture remain null: later official cards checked do not provide an exact-preview mapping. Open-checkpoint weights and license are not assigned to the preview. Parent review leaves exact weight availability and license unverified rather than inferring closed weights from hosting or absent search results.
